bake_A_ppo_scratch.name: bake_scratch
bake_A_ppo_scratch.note: Bake-off candidate A: PPO from scratch (random 2x128 network) on the real task only. Reward: game score + 200 for resting between the flags, -100 off-pad rest, -100 timeout.

stages.name: real task
stages.expect: Learns to fly and land within ~10-20M steps; unlikely to beat the 84% pilot within 45 minutes.

bake_B_ppo_warm.name: bake_warm
bake_B_ppo_warm.note: Bake-off candidate B: PPO warm-started from the behaviour clone of pilot v2 (2x128, 83.5%), critic trained alone for 15 iterations first on the real task only. Reward: game score + 200 for resting between the flags, -100 off-pad rest, -100 timeout.

stages.name: real task
stages.expect: Starts at ~84% and climbs, as gradients use every step of experience. Risk: the first updates damage the clone.

M1.name: M1
M1.note: Main run 1. The bake-off winner (PPO from a random 2x128 network, 45 min, 42 M steps, 91.4% on 500 shared analysis flights) continues: same network, same optimiser state. Stage 1 keeps learning on the real task (it was still improving). Stage 2: hard cases, 30% of flights re-fly real-task seeds it failed on recent checks (each check uses fresh seeds, so later checks stay clean). Stage 3: fine-tune with a lower learning rate and less exploration.

stages.name: real task, keep learning
stages.expect: The check average was still rising (90.8% at 26 M steps -> 93.8% at 39 M). Expect ~95% within 2 hours, boulder hits falling from ~5% to ~3%.

stages.name: hard cases
stages.expect: The remaining failures are rare situations (mostly the boulder 1-2.5 m off centre). Seeing them 30% of the time instead of ~5% should lift them by 1-2 points.

stages.name: fine-tune
stages.expect: Smaller, steadier steps: less noise in the policy, the last point or two.

M2.name: M2
M2.note: Main run 2 continues M1 (96.6% [95.3-97.6] on 1,000 fresh selection flights after 80 M steps). M1's curriculum ended too early: its 200+200-flight pass checks were passed by luck after many tries. M2 has one long stage that never ends by itself: hard cases (30% of flights re-fly real-task seeds failed on recent checks) with the fine-tune settings (learning rate 1e-4, entropy bonus 0.003). A snapshot every 100 iterations; champions are chosen afterwards on 1,000 selection flights, never on the checks.

stages.name: hard cases, fine-tune, no early stop
stages.expect: Hard cases took the checks from 92.7% to ~96.3% in 40 M steps. Expect a slower climb toward 97.5-98% over the night; remaining failures: boulder 1.7%, timeout 1.1%, crash 0.5%.
